content: भर {%a.%} [भृ-अप्] Bearing, granting, supporting, <ab>&c.</ab> (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>). .{@-रः@} .²1 A burden, load, weight; खुरत्रये भरं कृत्वा <ls>Pt.</ls> ‘supporting himself on his three hoofs’; फलभरपरिणामश्यामजम्बू <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>U. 2. 20</ls>; भरव्यथा <ls>Mu. 2. 18</ls>; <ls>Ki. 11. 5</ls>. .²2 A great number, large quantity, collection, multitude; धत्ते भरं कुसुमपत्रफलावलीनाम् <ls>Bv. 1. 94</ls>, <ls n="Bv. 1.">54</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 47</ls>. .²3 Bulk, mass. .²4 Excess; ततो भक्तिश्रद्धाभरगुरुगृणद्भ्यां गिरिश यत् <ls>Śivamahimna 10</ls>; निर्व्यूढसौहृदभरेति गुणोज्ज्वलेति <ls>Māl. 6. 17</ls>; शोभाभरैः संभृताः <ls>Bv. 1. 103</ls>; कोपभरेण <ls>Gīt. 3</ls>. .²5 A particular measure of weight. .²6 Theft, taking away. .²7 Attacking, a battle (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²8 A hymn or song of praise. .²9 Pre-eminence, excellence; न खलु वयसा जात्यैवायं स्वकार्यसहो भरः <ls>V. 5. 18</ls>.
